summary_markdown:
## Behaviour changes
1. (user_visible) After a reload (/compact, /rewind, a return to a session keryx released, a restart) a run card whose run can no longer change (closed before it finished, could not start, not sent; its tab closed) is gone instead of moving below the newest message. Cards that can still change (starting, running, waiting, or with their tab open) stay at the end. Alternative: keep final cards in place after the item they followed (needs an anchor keryx does not store).
2. (user_visible) A Run result whose output is one line longer than 16 KiB at the cut point now sends only the cut line: a byte cut never starts inside a line (SC3-001). Alternative: keep the fragment of a single over-long line, which reopens the secret-prefix case.
3. (user_visible) Output the host's 1 MiB ring dropped is now said: the result starts with the cut line even under the caps, and the ring's partial first line is left out (LG2-002).
4. (user_visible, screen readers) A live run card's status is role=status in every state; a change into closed / could not start / not sent is said assertively (aria-live), and nothing is said when a card mounts (reload, session switch). No role=alert any more.
5. (user_visible) A results prompt that got no answer because keryx exited or was restarted goes back to waiting (the card no longer says sent) and is sent again once the session is held again; keryx (T13) answers success for runs it already stored.
6. (user_visible) Once a load holds a session again, resumed issue questions and a turn started as the load resolves (a session review) go before the Run results that waited; an issue-question resume refused because the slot is taken is queued, and openIssueSession fails when the resume was neither sent nor queued.
7. (user_visible) Send output now whose tail is being read when the tab closes still delivers that snapshot once (AC8's exception); the card stays 'running…' during that read instead of flashing 'closed'.
8. (needs_operator: none) .github/workflows/desktop-check.yml also runs for src/acp/terminal-result.ts and src/session/terminal-note.ts.

## Not verified
- No screen reader was run; the announcement tests use a DOM model of the live-region rules.
- The real app was not launched; the hook is covered through the IPC-mocked fixture only.
- T13's duplicate answer was not exercised against the real keryx; the fixture hand-writes the agreed shape.
- The whole desktop suite was not run (owner instruction: CI is the suite evidence).
